title: Saving Sea Turtles
text: 0:28 / 2:02 .75x 1x 1.25x 1.5x 1.75x 2x Meet Sea Turtles There are seven species of sea turtles. Each species has a shell for protection. Each species has strong flippers for swimming. Learn more about sea turtles. Turtle Diet This sea turtle is chasing a jellyfish. Some sea turtles also eat plants. They eat seaweed and algae. A Long Journey Sea turtles live in the water. But they lay eggs on land. Baby turtles hurry to the ocean when they hatch. Sharp Eyes Sea turtles have good eyesight. They can see in dark water. And they can see colors. Their eyesight helps them hunt. Turtles in Trouble There is trash in the ocean. That is a problem for turtles. See this bag? A turtle might think it is food. AI ANGEL GENTEL—GETTY IMAGES; KJORGEN—GETTY IMAGES; M.M. SWEET—GETTY IMAGES; ANTONIO BUSIELLO—GETTY IMAGES. BACKGROUND: ABSTRACT AERIAL ART/GETTY IMAGES Saving Sea Turtles Grace Buschiazzo is a marine biologist. She works at the South Carolina Aquarium. She is part of its Sea Turtle Care Center. Turtle Rescue Sea turtles can get sick. They can get hurt. The team at the care center treats them. A Trip to the Doctor This turtle is getting scanned. It has to be strong and healthy. Then it can go back to the sea. Good as New Another turtle swallowed fishing line. Doctors did surgery. They removed it. The turtle was saved.
